blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) Panthers got their revenge on the University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons, pulling off a 74-69 victory in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday, November 8, at the Cebu Coliseum. The victory gave both teams identical 2-9 win-loss records as the second round of the tournament intensified. For the Panthers, it was a sweet revenge after UP Cebu handed them a 72-57 defeat in their first-round meeting on October 2.
